camel_example: aliyun ram CreateLoginProfile --region cn-hangzhou --PasswordResetRequired false --UserName zhangq0000 --MFABindRequired false --Password mypassword
description_en: Enables console logon for a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 调用CreateLoginProfile接口为一个RAM用户启用Web控制台登录
kebab_example: aliyun ram create-login-profile --user-name zhangq0000 --password mypassword --password-reset-required false --mfa-bind-required false --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLoginProfile

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM user
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en: The logon password of the RAM user. The password must meet the password strength requirements. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2337691.html
parameters.help_zh: 指定密码，密码必须符合密码强度要求。关于密码强度设置要求，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2337691.html
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the RAM user has to change the password upon logon. Default value: `false`
parameters.help_zh: 指定用户在登录时是否需要修改密码。默认为`false`
parameters.name: password_reset_required

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the RAM user must bind a multi-factor authentication (MFA) device upon the next logon. Default value: `false`
parameters.help_zh: 指定用户在下次登录时是否必须绑定多因素认证器。默认为`false`
parameters.name: mfa_bind_required

LoginProfile.description_en: The logon configurations of the RAM user

CreateDate.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 UTC 时间，格式为 `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

MFABindRequired.description_en: Indicates whether an MFA device must be bound to the RAM user
MFABindRequired.description_zh: 要求必须绑定多因素认证设备

PasswordResetRequired.description_en: Indicates whether the RAM user must change the password upon logon
PasswordResetRequired.description_zh: 要求下次登录时重设密码

UserName.description_en: The name of the RAM user
